messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-4821 (severity: P1). reason=az4 egress errors > threshold (5xx spike). routing_policy=regional-fallback
pd-bot: Alert routed to oncall-sre (rotation: janet_liu). escalation policy active.
Janet Liu: acked the page :white_check_mark: I'm on it, starting triage. tagging @Matt O'Neal for infra nets.
Matt O'Neal: looking now. I'm seeing NIC errors on hostpool az4-rg-3, kernel OOPS logs for eth0 on a subset of hosts. attaching quick grep output: `grep -n "NETDEV WATCHDOG" /var/log/kern.log | head -n 5`
Janet Liu: thanks. initial impact check — any customer-facing 5xx counts? @DX Support can you confirm?
DX Support: monitoring shows elevated 502/504 from region eu-west-az4 for the last 4m. Spike peaked ~3.8% of requests, currently ~2.1%. Some customers reporting timeouts in support queue.
Chloe Park: console traces show tail latency > 1.5s for certain models served from az4, token throughput dropping.
Priya Singh: Product ops — customers with pinned Dedicated in eu-west might be affected. Notifying account teams for impacted tenants with >10% traffic through az4.
Sam Patel: gathering customer list now, will DM security-sensitive details.
Janet Liu: scope: az4 only, no region-wide control plane failures. Root cause candidate: NIC driver flapping after recent host kernel update. Confirming whether a canary host reboot rolled forward.
Maria Chen: infra runbook step 1: quarantine affected hosts, remove from load balancer. Running `rb remove-host --hostpool az4-rg-3 --filter "kernel:5.18"`
Matt O'Neal: removing 6 hosts from LB now. Expect small capacity dip. Also triggering warmpool scale-up in az2 as fallback: `infra scale warmpool eu-west az2 +15`
incident-bot: automated action: warmpool scale request queued (id=wp-9342).
Janet Liu: enable regional routing fallback to az2 for non-pinned traffic. This is a staged rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 2m observation windows.
Chloe Park: putting canary diversion at 10% now. Watch for error regression in az2.
deploy-bot: route-change plan applied: diversion=10% -> target=az2, config-id=route-az4-fallback-2025-03.
Janet Liu: can everyone keep posts short: what you're doing and why. Matt, Maria please confirm if we should reimage hosts or just rollback kernel.
Matt O'Neal: kernel rollback less safe; recommending reimage to current stable AMI (ami-rlw-202502) after host replacement tests. Queueing reimage for 6 hosts; will do during next 8m window in batches of 2.
Maria Chen: reimage job created job=ri-4721. Starting batch 1 (2 hosts).
Chloe Park: metric check at 10m: az4 5xx dropped from 3.8% -> 1.6% post-diversion, latency improving but still some tail spikes. Az2 stable at baseline.
Priya Singh: customer impact estimate: ~4% of total EU requests experienced >500ms latency; ~2% had 5xx. No broad data loss, requests being retried by SDKs.
Janet Liu: communications: draft short status update for the status page and customer DRI. Sam, can you prepare a short blurb we can push to status.redwood.ai? Keep it factual, mention mitigation in progress.
Sam Patel: working on it. Draft: "We are investigating increased error rates and latency affecting some requests in eu-west-az4. We have activated regional fallback to eu-west-az2 and are removing affected hosts. No customer data loss observed. More updates in 15 minutes."
Janet Liu: post that now.
DX Support: posted status update and linked PD.
SRE-runbook-bot: Reminder: if diversion >25% for >10m, escalate to oncall-infra-lead.
incident-bot: automated escalation check at +12m: diversion=10% for 12m, error rate trending down. no auto-escalation triggered.
Matt O'Neal: batch 1 reimage complete, hosts healthy. batch 2 started. Observed NIC interrupt counters reset post-reimage.
Chloe Park: after batch2, az4 5xx down to 0.7%, tail latency back near baseline.
Janet Liu: good. scaling warmpool back to baseline now (remove step). Confirming LB re-add only after host health checks pass.
Maria Chen: LB add queued, healthchecks green for 4/6 reimaged hosts. Adding 2 hosts now.
Priya Singh: reps notified for affected customers; tickets open for higher-touch accounts.
Matt O'Neal: starting forensic collection on affected hosts (`/var/log/kern.log`, `dmesg`, nic firmware version). uploading artifacts to infra-drive/job-ri-4721.
Janet Liu: any need for PD escalation? right now mitigation effective, I'll keep this as active incident but not escalate.
Chloe Park: recommendation: add a preflight check to kernel rollout pipeline to watch netdev metrics for 30m before wider rollout. Filing infra-ticket: INFRA-2019.
Sam Patel: customers asked about root cause; holding messaging until forensic completes. ETA 4h for initial RCA.
Janet Liu: ok. final ops for now: keep routing fallback in place but at 0% (i.e., not diverting), continue host reimages until all affected hosts healthy, collect artifacts, create postmortem and link PD incident. Handoff to night oncall at +2h if still open.
incident-bot: PD#INC-4821 marked as "mitigated" by oncall (Janet Liu) at 1749999990.
Janet Liu: handing to night oncall @Matt O'Neal for monitoring for 2h and then closure. Leaving notes in PD. :wave:
Matt O'Neal: taking handoff, will monitor dashboards and ticks. If anything flares, I'll wake the infra lead.
Chloe Park: added monitoring alert tweak to reduce noisy retries (2m cooldown).
Janet Liu: filed postmortem ticket PM-az4-nic-flap-2025; assigning to Matt + Maria. Closing root thread for now. Thanks all :team-heart:
